subject: Request: temporary net60 request + VAT routing — proposed phased remit
messages:
From: Sophie Barnes <sophie@aldosmedical.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Temporary net60 request due to treasury lag

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last month — Redwood has been great for our pilot. I need to flag a short-term cashflow squeeze on our side: our treasury is experiencing a delay in invoice funding for a tranche of grants, and we expect a 6–8 week timing gap on receivables.

Could Aldos move the next three invoices on Net60 for 60 days from invoice date while we bridge the timing? We can provide a signed PO for the full amount (attached).

To address Redwood's risk and VAT handling:
- We're open to a security deposit or a short-term letter of credit — whatever is simplest for your finance/legal.
- We need VAT invoices addressed to our EU subsidiary (Aldos Medical EU, VAT ID: EU123456789) so we can reclaim VAT when the credit hits.

Attachment: Aldos-PO-6789.pdf (PO for pilot expansion)

Can you let me know what documentation Redwood would need and any bridging steps? Looking to avoid interrupting the pilot.

Best,
Sophie Barnes
Head of Ops, Aldos Medical
Sophie Barnes | Aldos Medical
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie@aldosmedical.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T12:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Temporary net60 request due to treasury lag

Hi Sophie — thanks for the context and the PO. Appreciate the heads up.

We can work with a temporary extension but need to balance credit exposure and VAT routing. Proposed approach below; I am looping in finance (Vivek) and legal/ops (Laura) to lock details:

Proposed phased remit (attached spreadsheet):
1) Initial 25% deposit due on PO execution (applies to the next invoice)
2) Remaining 75% billed on Net45 for the following two invoices with a rolling credit cap equal to the outstanding balance + 10% buffer
3) If any payment is >7 days late beyond Net45, Redwood automatically converts the next invoice to prepayment until the account is made current

VAT routing and invoicing:
- We will issue VAT invoices to Aldos Medical EU with the VAT ID you provided. Please confirm the exact legal name and registry address for the invoice header.

Risk mitigant:
- We require either a refundable security deposit equal to 10% of the contracted amount or a short credit safeguard letter from your bank (template attached).

If that looks acceptable to you, we can sign the PO and push the DocuSign envelope; Vivek, please confirm the credit buffer and whether finance will accept deposit vs letter of credit. Laura, can legal prepare a brief credit safeguard letter template for their counsel?

Attachment: proposed-phased-remit.xlsx

Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:18:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Temporary net60 request due to treasury lag

Neha,

Finance is comfortable with a conditional approval. Quick points:
- Prefering net45 instead of net60 to reduce tail risk, but we can accept net60 only if Aldos provides the 10% refundable deposit or a bank-issued credit safeguard letter.
- Credit cap at outstanding balance + 10% buffer is fine.
- Auto-conversion to prepayment after 7 days delinquent is required.

If Aldos sends the deposit or signed letter within 5 business days of PO signing, we will accept the phased remit schedule. Otherwise, we require prepayment for the first renewed invoice.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Barnes <sophie@aldosmedical.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Aldos Medical Finance <finance@aldosmedical.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:46:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Temporary net60 request due to treasury lag

Neha, Vivek — thanks for the rapid reply. We can move on the deposit route to keep things simple. Confirmations: 
- Aldos will transfer a refundable 10% deposit within 3 business days after DocuSign completes.
- We accept your auto-conversion to prepayment if delinquency triggers.
- Please issue VAT invoices to: Aldos Medical EU, Aldos Medical EU Ltd., 12 Rue de la Santé, 75005 Paris, VAT ID: EU123456789.

I've attached the signed PO and will route the deposit from our finance team. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood needs any beneficiary routing details for the deposit (bank account, reference)?

Attachment: Aldos-PO-6789.pdf (signed)
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/track/ABC123

Sophie
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie@aldosmedical.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-26T15:34:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Temporary net60 request due to treasury lag — confirmation and next steps

Sophie — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the signed PO. Confirming next steps and timelines: 

1) DocuSign shows the envelope completed (link above). I will send a payment instruction email to Aldos finance with Redwood's bank routing and a required reference string (ALDOS-DEAL-4913-DEPOSIT). Please execute the 10% refundable deposit within 3 business days.

2) Laura will produce the credit safeguard letter template for Aldos counsel; if Aldos prefers a letter of credit instead of the deposit, we can accept that but need it before the Net45 terms take effect. Laura, can you share the template by EOD?

3) Once deposit is received, Redwood will switch the billing schedule to the phased remit (25% deposit credited, remainder Net45). VAT invoices will be issued to Aldos Medical EU with the legal header you provided.

4) I've logged this in HubSpot (deal id DEAL-4913) and updated the payment plan; finance will monitor the account and trigger prepayment fallback if a delinquency >7 days occurs.

Thanks — we'll treat this as high priority to avoid any interruption to the pilot.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Related link: https://hubspot.com/deal/4913
